title: 2008 AMC 12A Problem 4
statement: Which of the following is equal to the product \[ \begin{aligned} &\dfrac{8}{4} \cdot \dfrac{12}{8} \cdot \dfrac{16}{12} \\ &\quad \cdots \dfrac{4n + 4}{4n} \cdots \dfrac{2008}{2004}? \end{aligned} \]

solutions.text:
Every denominator except the first cancels with the numerator of the preceding fraction, so the product collapses to \[ \dfrac{2008}{4} = 502. \]

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Each denominator cancels with the numerator of the previous fraction
Only the last numerator and the first denominator survive
